response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Not much has changed. I've got as much work to do as before... but that's fine. Better to have something to do rather than nothing.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: *sigh* Were I to go wandering around, I fear people would start talking again, *sigh*...

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: I never imagined that Uncle Hawka had commissioned her to frame me and drag me down into the mud...

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: I'm sure you've heard the talk about how quite a few family members of mine have been expelled from the tribe. Yet here I remain.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Those who've headed out from the tribe to the rest of Natlan sometimes send messages to me, and Uncle Hawka once did just that, saying he could help me find work at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame...

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: How could I agree to that? I prefer my current life, so I hope they just give up and quit bothering me — and the sooner, the better.

response.speaker: Paran
response.text: Speaking of which, the Saurus Crackers they've supplied have been of really good quality, apart from that last batch... If only we could get our hands on them someplace else.

choices.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.
